chunks.text:
Product Profile
CR Dhan 1009 sub 1 is a high-yielding, submergence-tolerant, late-maturing, semidwarf variety, characterized by short bold grains. It's a newer version derived from the Savitri variety, specifically suited for cultivation in eastern India. Demonstrating high adaptability to flood-prone, rain-fed shallow lowlands, it exhibits moderate resistance to BPH, WBPH, brown spot, and leaf blast. It has intermediate gelatinization temperature and soft gel consistency indicating its similarity to CR Dhan 1009. Rice from this variety is widely favored for idli making in South India.

Considerations
- Little sticky
- Bold grain
- High yield
- Late maturity; Profuse tillering (16-20)
- Submergence tolerance
- Resistant to BPH, WBPH, brown spot and leaf blast.
- Medium tall genotype
